data.name: Aamiya
data.gender_notes: Aamiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'A-M-M' meaning 'mother'. The name Aamiya is a feminine form that refers to the mothers of the believers in Islam. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Islamic tradition. The name Aamiya carries the meaning “Mother of the believers” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aamiya usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the believers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nourishing the soul and providing spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Aamiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother of the believers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aamiya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: عآميا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني العمى أو عدم البصر الروحي
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم 'عآميا' هو اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل 'عَمِيَ' الذي يعني العمى أو عدم البصر. في سياق روحي، قد يشير إلى عدم الإدراك الروحي أو الحقيقة. ومع ذلك، في الاسم، قد يكون له معنى أكثر إيجابية، مثل 'المرأة التي تتبع بصيرة داخلية' أو 'المرأة التي تتمتع برؤية روحية داخلية'. يعود أصول الاسم إلى اللغة العربية القديمة.

in_urdu.name: عامیا
in_urdu.meaning: روحانی اندھیرے یا باطنی بصیرت کی مالک
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام 'عامیا' ایک نسائی نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے فعل 'عَمِيَ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اندھیرا یا عدم بصیرت۔ روحانی سیاق میں، یہ نام اندرونی بصیرت یا روحانی بیداری کی سطح پر اشارہ کر سکتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام روحانی رہنمائی اور اندرونی روشنائی کی مالک کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

Historically, the name Aamiya has been used in various Muslim cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and timeless relevance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aamiya holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic communities as it is a name given to girls with deep connections to motherhood and nurturing. It reflects the values of love, care, and compassion, emphasizing the importance of family and maternal love.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Aamiya holds deep symbolism as it reminds us of the motherly love and care of Allah (God) towards His creation. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) said, "Paradise lies beneath the shades and in the shadow of mothers." This reflects the immense spiritual value of the role of mothers in nurturing and guiding their children on the path to righteousness and faith. Moreover, the name Aamiya is also a reminder of the Prophet Mohammad's (PBUH) mother, Amina bint Wahb, who played a crucial role in raising him to be a great leader and role model for all Muslims.
